confirm.title: HA Server Monitor agent discovered
confirm.description: Found an HA Server Monitor agent at {host} (hostname: {name}). Add it and pair it now?

user.title: Add an HA Server Monitor agent manually
user.description: Use this if the agent wasn't auto-discovered via mDNS (different subnet, Avahi not reachable, etc). Enter the host running the ha-server-monitor-agent package.

abort.already_configured: This HA Server Monitor agent is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the agent's /info endpoint at that host/port. Check it's running (systemctl status ha-server-monitor-agent) and reachable.
abort.already_paired: That agent is already paired with a different Home Assistant instance/entry. Clear its state file and restart it to re-pair (see the ha-server-monitor-agent project's README).
